basics.type: Private engineering college run by the Himalayan Charitable Trust, approved by AICTE
basics.ugc: B.Tech, BBA and MBA degrees awarded by Veer Madho Singh Bhandari Uttarakhand Technical University; allied health affiliated to HNB Uttarakhand Medical Education University
basics.other: B.Tech (CSE, CSE AI & ML, ECE, Electrical, Civil, Mechanical), BBA, MBA, pharmacy and allied health

naac.score: CGPA 3.62, on NAAC's list of 14 August 2025

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths, 50% (60% in PCM for Mechanical)
Online entrance test in Physics, Chemistry and Maths, sometimes an interview; seats on merit. Lateral entry for diploma and B.Sc holders

scholarships.text: Scholarships for high scorers in JEE Main and Class 12, including the merit-based Founder's Scholarship, plus help with education loans.

hostel.text: Hostel and mess cost ₹80,000 to ₹1,20,000 a year.

fees.text: Annual tuition for the 2026 intake: B.Tech Civil and Mechanical ₹1,09,900, B.Tech CSE ₹1,59,900 and B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) ₹1,69,900.
